executive_summary.text: Cost year 2024: direct care cost was $207.78 per resident day (44.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $169.07.
Cost year 2024: nursing home operating margin was 3.9% (Connecticut median 0.5%).
Cost year 2024: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $436,619, 12.0% of the $3,639,437 direct care cost.

Cost year 2024: dietary cost $553,723, $31.61 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.6). Wages $304,877 (55.1%), allocated fringe $44,810 (8.1%), non-wage costs $204,036 (36.8%). Raw food was $184,155 ($10.51 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.59).
Cost year 2024: housekeeping cost $248,820, $14.21 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.07). Wages $188,746 (75.9%), allocated fringe $27,741 (11.1%), non-wage costs $32,333 (13.0%).
Cost year 2024: laundry cost $62,549, $3.57 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.41). Wages $37,861 (60.5%), allocated fringe $5,565 (8.9%), non-wage costs $19,123 (30.6%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075335/financials.json.

Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2017 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
